# saas-bootstrap-template

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/Llamitai/saas-bootstrap-template?label=release&sort=semver)](https://github.com/Llamitai/saas-bootstrap-template/tags)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Llamitai/saas-bootstrap-template)](https://github.com/Llamitai/saas-bootstrap-template/blob/main/LICENSE)
[![Copier](https://img.shields.io/badge/generated%20with-Copier-orange)](https://copier.readthedocs.io)
[![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.14-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://www.python.org)
[![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-009688?logo=fastapi&logoColor=white)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com)
[![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-000000?logo=nextdotjs&logoColor=white)](https://nextjs.org)

Copier template for multi-tenant, authenticated B2B SaaS products: a FastAPI
backend (Clean Architecture + DDD), a Next.js frontend, a documentation site,
and the batteries already wired — sessions with Google OAuth, tenants and
members with invitations, roles, and permissions, asset storage, transactional
messaging, and Directus as the internal admin console.

> **This repository is 100% generated by an automated release pipeline —
> never edit it by hand and do not open pull requests here.** Every release
> overwrites this tree, and published tags are never moved.

## Generate a project

```bash
uvx copier copy --trust gh:Llamitai/saas-bootstrap-template my-app
```

`--trust` is required because the template declares `_tasks`
(`cp backend/.env.example backend/.env` and `git init`, first copy only).

After generating, regenerate the backend lockfile before any production
build:

```bash
cd my-app/backend && uv lock
```

## Keep developing

Every generated project ships a `justfile`; run these from the project root:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `just dev-all` | Bring up backend, frontend, and docs together |
| `just backend dev` | Run the API and its local infrastructure (Docker) |
| `just frontend dev` | Run the Next.js app in dev mode |
| `just docs dev` | Run the documentation site |
| `just backend test` | Backend test suite |
| `just backend lint` / `just backend typecheck` | Backend lint / type checking |
| `just backend new-migration` / `just backend migrate` | Create / apply database migrations |
| `just backend seed` | Seed roles, users, and an admin account |
| `just frontend test` / `just frontend e2e` | Frontend unit tests / Playwright end-to-end suite |
| `just frontend lint` / `just frontend typecheck` | Frontend lint / type checking |
| `just verify` | Full verification pass across the whole project |
| `just stop-all` | Stop every running service |

`just backend`, `just frontend`, and `just docs` list every recipe available
in each module.

## Update to a newer template release

```bash
cd my-app && uvx copier update --trust
```

Copier runs a 3-way merge against the release your project was generated
from; review the resulting diff before committing.
